✨ **Client Spotlight: Amari Vitality** ✨

We had the privilege of visiting one of our newest clients, **Amari Vitality in Cookeville, Tennessee**, and helping prepare their team for an exciting new chapter of growth!

This may be their current location, but right next door, they’re building a **beautiful new two-story spa** that we cannot wait to see come to life and eventually showcase. 😍

For now, we’re working behind the scenes to help make sure the strategy, systems, and foundation are ready for their next level of expansion.

Big things are coming for Amari Vitality, and we’re excited to be part of the journey! 🥂✨

#MedSpa #AmariVitality #TheLuxoraCollective #MedSpaGrowth #Aesthetics #CookevilleTN #ClientSpotlight
:::
